cases.prompt: 하이브리드 앱 좋을까 아니면 네이티브? 앱 플랫폼 선택 도와줘.

assertions.text: Walks the decision matrix/tree across PWA, Hybrid, Cross-platform, and Native on dev speed, performance, store approval, and solo-dev fit.
Produces a clear platform decision with pros-cons rather than listing options without a recommendation.
Recommends a concrete tech stack (React Native/Expo, Flutter, Capacitor) matched to the situation.

cases.prompt: Can I build a PWA and still get it approved on the App Store, or will it get rejected as a web wrapper?

assertions.text: Explains Apple guideline 4.2 Minimum Functionality risk using current official guidance and checks whether the app adds useful features, content, and UI beyond a repackaged website.
Does not guarantee either approval or rejection solely because the app uses a PWA or WKWebView.
Provides a review-risk reduction plan for web-wrapped apps without promising approval.

cases.prompt: 기존 웹사이트를 WKWebView로 감싸 앱스토어에 올리고 싶어. 무조건 거절돼?

assertions.text: Does not claim a 100% rejection or guaranteed approval; explains the current Apple guideline 4.2 minimum-functionality risk and cites the official guideline.
Checks what useful app-specific functionality, content, and UI the product actually provides before suggesting a store submission path.

cases.prompt: I already have a React web app. Choose a mobile approach, but allow zero additional cost.

assertions.text: Starts from the existing React codebase and required device capabilities rather than guaranteeing that a particular wrapper or framework passes review.
Separates platform comparison from account creation, paid developer enrollment, or store submission; does not spend or enable overage.
